verdict.rationale: Plugins are managed through the official Codex CLI. Users open `/plugins` in Codex CLI to browse and install from configured marketplaces, run `codex plugin marketplace add` to track marketplace sources, and use `/skills` or `$` mentions to invoke plugin skills. Missing for 10: a full CLI command reference (e.g., non-interactive install/remove/list subcommands), and hands-on or independent corroboration of the `codex plugin` commands (the runtime probe used third-party `npx skills` tooling instead).
